## ABN AMRO leads cluster of new institutional positions in Palo Alto Networks with $281.59 million investment

The ABN AMRO position size is worth flagging as incremental institutional conviction at scale, though flow data alone carries no fundamental signal. Noteworthy as part of a broader pattern of PANW accumulation across multiple institutions.

- ABN AMRO Bank invested $281.59 million in PANW — the largest single allocation in this cluster.
- Three additional firms — Focus Partners, SFE Investment Counsel, and TFR Capital — also initiated positions.
- ABN AMRO's position size is notably large relative to the other initiations in this cycle.
- Routine flow data; no company-specific or competitive catalyst identified in coverage.
